title: Potential infinite loop
detail: The `_reset()` method is called without a condition to check if the connection is still keep-alive. This could lead to an infinite loop if the connection is not properly closed.

title: Potential memory leak
detail: The code only removes closed streams from the `_streams` list. If a stream is not properly closed, it will remain in the list, potentially leading to a memory leak.
